cohort: The study discusses the management of term breech pregnancies, focusing on foetuses presenting in breech in late gestation.
finding: Adequate management of term breech pregnancies requires comprehensive screening and evaluation of various antenatal factors beyond the mode of delivery, including foetal weight, growth, mobility, obstetric history, gestational disorders, and pelvic size.
mod_finding: The management plan, including external cephalic version and the choice of delivery route, should be individualized and organized on a case-by-case basis after thorough evaluation of maternal/foetal conditions and associated disorders.
